title: Notifications
emptyBody: Requests, approvals and event changes show up here.

type.JOIN_REQUESTED: There's a new request to join {{event}}.
type.SPOT_OPENED: A spot opened in {{event}}; players are waiting.
type.EVENT_CHANGED: The time or place of {{event}} changed.
type.ATTENDANCE_FINALIZED: Attendance for {{event}} is final. Check your attendance and review the people you played with.
type.REPORT_OUTCOME: We looked at your report. Thank you.
type.ATTENDANCE_REMINDER: {{event}} has ended. Mark attendance and finalize it; if you do not, the system finalizes it for you soon.

push.promptBody: If you like, we can tell you about your own events, send new events that suit you and an occasional reminder. Choose what you want.
push.activity: My events: join requests for your events and approval of your requests
push.recommendations: Events for you: new games for your sports and province (at most 1 a day)
push.reminders: Reminders: events in your province when you have not been around for a while (at most 2 a week)
push.changeLater: You can change this any time in Settings › Notifications.
push.blocked: Your phone does not allow notifications from this app. You can turn them on in the phone's settings.
push.help: Notifications never contain your name, your location or message text; tapping one opens the event.
push.testSent: Test notification sent; it arrives within a minute.
push.noDevice: This phone is not registered yet: allow notifications first.
push.webOnlyNote: Notifications work in the phone app; turn them on there.
